title: 祭りはひとりじゃできやしねえ

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Pant… Pant… Pant…

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: A few days have passed since Inari One's interview was broadcast on TV. She's been pouring herself into training, as she always does. However…
choice_data_list: (Is it really okay to leave things like this?)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Inari One's goal to reach the top of the regionals was born from her love of Oi.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: But her intentions could go to waste if she does nothing to settle the discord between her and Chief—or I could say, between her and all of Oi itself.
choice_data_list: (I just can't sit by and watch!)

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: Another day later… Without notifying Inari One, I decide to make a trip all the way to Oi Racecourse.

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Whoa! I know you, you're Inari's trainer! Did ya come alone today?
choice_data_list: I wanted to speak with Chief…

text_block_list.name: Racer with Purple Scrunchie
text_block_list.text: Chief? Sure, just gimme a sec. Chief, you have a gueeest!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: For goodness' sake! Ya don't gotta scream at me to get my—wait, it's you…
choice_data_list: I want to talk to you about Inari.

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I explain to him why Inari One wants to compete in the regionals and her long-term goal.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: She wants to proudly declare that the regionals aren't a step below the centrals… by reachin' the top of both of 'em?

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Geez, she's a real piece of work.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Gotta go 'n' make things hard for me, doesn't she? But I'll agree to what she's tryna do.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Doesn't mean I've forgiven her, though… I accept it, but I don't like it one bit!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Sorry if I'm buttin' in, Trainer, but I trust you'll let me come back to the academy with ya. I got a few words to exchange with that girl.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huff, huff, huff…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I gotta run even more. Otherwise, I don't have a chance of beatin' anyone from Oi!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Well, will ya look at that! Good to know you're puttin' some heart into your trainin', Inari!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Uh… Huh?! Chief?! What're ya doin' here?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Don't tell me…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Why'd ya go and bring him here?!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Watch your mouth, brat!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Your trainer came lookin' for me outta grave concern over your situation.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: So don't go actin' shocked… That wouldn't be fittin' for an Oi girl.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Inari. I know what you're tryna do. I fully understand, but…

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: I don't like it. No, I don't like it one bit! What're ya doin' actin' so stupid?!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I know… I can't defend myself on this one. I'm goin' against what ya told me by runnin' in the regionals instead of the centrals.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Forget that crap! I'm not worried about that at all!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: …Huh?

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: I wanna know why ya won't stand tall and say you're aimin' for the top.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I-I mean, I can't just say somethin' like that… 'Specially knowin' how strong everyone in Oi is.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Ya see?! That's exactly what I don't like!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Huh?!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: You're tryna act all tough, but you're nothin' but a scaredy-cat! If it's the top you want, come at us with your head held high, fair and square!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Or are ya plannin' to mosey your way up to the top without givin' us a chance to fight? I tell ya, this idiot!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: What's the top even mean for ya in the first place?!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Quit thinkin' you're the only one who knows the right thing to do.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: You're not the only one on this journey, you know. Yet here ya are, ignorin' your trainer.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Sounds to me like your time here at Tracen has made you forget something important, Inari.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: And that's… that ya can't put on a festival alone.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: All right, lemme cut to the chase…

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Central racer Inari One, listen up and listen good!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: I, as representative of Oi, accept your challenge! But just so you know…

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: We're the ones who're gonna stand at the top!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Thanks, Chief. I really appreciate ya…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I'm Inari One, and I'm makin' this statement right here! With all my body 'n' soul, I will stand victorious on the grounds of Oi…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And take the top of the regionals!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: So when that time comes, get ready to rumble!

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: Heh! Right back atcha.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: If you wanna reach the top so bad, come and get it, ya big dummy.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: …Trainer, I'll be takin' my leave now. Thank ya for arrangin' my visit.

text_block_list.name: Chief
text_block_list.text: See ya, Inari. Ya better bulk up good. We're a strong bunch.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Yeah… I know that…

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's what makes gettin' to the top worthwhile!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Thanks for today, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: Thanks for today, Boss.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And… I'm sorry I made ya worry for nothin'.
choice_data_list: No, I'm sorry for forcing the conversation on you.
No, I'm sorry for forcing the conversation on you.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: That's all water under the bridge now! Let's turn over a new leaf. 'Cause I really learned somethin' today.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I made up my own ideas about how Chief felt… and I pushed forward not knowin' how you felt.

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: I ran off 'cause I couldn't face things head-on. I was so selfish… But that sorry act ends here!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: From now on, I'll speak my mind and stand proud! I'm gonna fight through the whole of Oi till I take the top!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And to do that… I'll be needin' your help!

text_block_list.name: Inari One
text_block_list.text: And to do that… I'll be needin' your help!

text_block_list.name: Monologue
text_block_list.text: I'm relieved to see the discord between Inari One and Chief has finally been resolved. This whole incident serves as a good reminder that the bond she has with her hometown is an unbreakable one.
